subject: Orbiton OneTrust portal onboarding: SSO metadata + SOC 2 snapshot
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@orbiton.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbiton.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: OneTrust portal onboarding + SSO metadata

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the intro form on the portal — Orbiton is looking to onboard Redwood into our OneTrust vendor program so procurement can complete their security review. Two quick asks to get the portal populated: 1) a short SOC 2 summary (we just need the attestation date + scope page), and 2) SAML metadata so our IdP team can validate the SSO link.

Can you confirm who on your side will be the evidence owner for this onboarding (and who we should share OneTrust access with)? We can provision a scoped reviewer account and the upload window once we have metadata.

Attaching: Orbiton_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (summary excerpt)

Cheers,
Maria
Vendor Security Program
Orbiton Systems

Attachment: Orbiton_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust portal onboarding + SSO metadata

Hi Maria — great to meet you over email. I’ll be the primary evidence owner for this onboarding. Jonas will run the OneTrust upload/manifest and Mina will help with SOC 2 scope mapping.

Quick plan proposal:
- Today (Nov 2): share our SAML metadata and a minimal SOC 2 extract (scope + dates).
- Nov 3–4: you provision a scoped reviewer account; we upload the initial evidence bundle and CSV manifest.
- Nov 8: follow-up call to confirm evidence resolution and any clarifications.

We have a short mutual-action-plan spreadsheet that tracks deliverables and due dates — I’ll attach it. For SAML we’ll provide orbiton-saml-metadata.xml and indicate the ACS/EntityID endpoints. If your IdP needs a test assertion, Jonas can coordinate a short test window.

Tags/notes for the portal: scope includes hosted inference service (api.redwood.ai), SOC 2 Type II (controls as of 2026-09-30), and SSO via SAML 2.0.

Thanks —
Grace O’Connor
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Initial_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@orbiton.com>, procurement@orbiton.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust portal onboarding + SSO metadata

Grace — thanks, this looks good. A couple of clarifying questions from our side: 1) Orbiton requires that evidence uploads include signed attestation pages for SOC 2 reports; can Mina confirm whether Redwood stores signed copies in the portal bundle? 2) For SSO, our IdP team needs the EntityID and a certificate fingerprint — can you drop the metadata file here or in the OneTrust ticket so we can assign a test slot?

We’ll provision a scoped uploader tomorrow morning (Nov 4) and send an invite to the reviewer account email you specify.

-David
Orbiton Vendor Risk Team

- Nov 5: Redwood uploads initial bundle (attestation, control narratives for in-scope services, SSO config)

- Nov 8: Joint verification call (30 min) if clarifications require deeper context
